name: motion-S01-adult-a
refs: Our signed adult S01, Pip (project-owned): the creature to repeat, exactly this Pip.
prompt: Paint a KEY POSE SHEET of the creature in the first reference: the SAME creature in every cell (same species, same face, eyes, markings, colours, leaf count, proportions, size and brush), only its pose changes. Layout: a grid of 3 columns by 2 rows of equal cells, each cell holds one full figure, centred, never touching the cell edges, all at the same scale, feet on one shared ground line in every row (except where the pose is in the air). Three-quarter view from the front left, facing the viewer, light from the top left, a soft flat contact shadow under each grounded pose. Matte painterly rendering exactly as the reference. Plain flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) background everywhere, no cell borders, no grid lines, no numbers, no text, no props, no ground, no glow. Cells, left to right, top row then bottom row: 1 standing exactly as the reference (the anchor); 2 crouch, body low and compressed, legs bent, ready to hop; 3 air, mid-hop, body stretched, all feet off the ground, lifted above the ground line; 4 curl, asleep, curled in a ball on the ground, eyes shut, leaves folded down; 5 standing exactly as cell 1 but with both eyes closed (a blink); cell 6 empty magenta.
